=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- N/A: whole PR scope | severity=critical | confidence=5

  PROBLEM: The PR targets the wrong files and removes existing Semble plumbing instead of implementing the judge-family prefetch change requested by issue #2408.
  WHY: Reviewers agree the required judge-family support already exists in the repo, while this PR changes unrelated paths and leaves the requested functionality unaddressed.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:115-128, 223-229 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: Replacing `issue_meta_matches_issue()` with `[ -s "${ISSUE_META_FILE:-}" ]` removes the issue-number check on cached metadata.
  WHY: A stale non-empty metadata file from another issue can now be trusted and feed the diagnose path the wrong labels/body.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:344-449 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The PR deletes the Semble diagnose infrastructure, including `source scripts/semble_helpers.sh`, `build_diagnose_semble_query()`, `DIAGNOSE_SEMBLE_QUERY_FILE`, and the `semble_query_block` injection.
  WHY: This removes the Semble context that existing diagnose-contract tests expect and degrades the post-Codex failure prompt.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:81-86, 134-139, 392-440 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The PR removes `_log_semble_event()` and the timing/logging path, so successful Semble queries no longer emit `SEMBLE_QUERY` telemetry and fallbacks no longer report `ms=`.
  WHY: Multiple `test_targeted_file_context.py` assertions expect those structured log lines, and the logs lose the ability to distinguish fast, slow, and failed queries.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:303-308, 392-397 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: Removing `_normalize_semble_max_chunks()` lets raw `--semble-max-chunks` values flow directly into `semble --top-k`.
  WHY: The prior 1..20 clamp is gone, so `0` and oversized values are no longer protected from invalid or excessive Semble requests.
- tests/test_judge_semble_prefetch_contract.py:81-95, 146-152 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The new source-pattern test hard-codes exact `render_prompt.sh` strings instead of checking behavior.
  WHY: Reviewers agree it is brittle to harmless refactors, and some note the test may also fail if the renderer implementation does not match those exact literals.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- N/A: whole PR scope | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The PR implements the opposite of what issue #2408 requested.
  WHY: The requested judge-family Semble prefetch wiring already exists, while this PR removes working Semble code from unrelated modules instead of adding the requested support.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:344-381 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The PR removes the Semble query construction and context injection for implement-diagnose prompts.
  WHY: `tests/test_implement_semble_contract.py` asserts the removed `source scripts/semble_helpers.sh`, `DIAGNOSE_SEMBLE_QUERY_FILE`, `build_diagnose_semble_query`, and `semble_query_block` lines.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:81-86, 134-139, 392-440 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The PR removes Semble telemetry and timing from the targeted-file-context overflow path.
  WHY: The success-path `SEMBLE_QUERY` log disappears and the fallback path loses `ms=`, which breaks `tests/test_targeted_file_context.py` expectations and removes observability.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:115-128 | severity=high | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The cached issue metadata guard no longer verifies that `.number` matches `ISSUE_NUMBER`.
  WHY: A stale metadata file from another issue can now pass the non-empty-file check and supply wrong labels/body content.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:303-308 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The `_normalize_semble_max_chunks()` clamp was removed.
  WHY: `--semble-max-chunks` now flows straight into `semble --top-k` without the prior 1..20 safety bound.
- tests/test_judge_semble_prefetch_contract.py:81-95 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The new test hard-codes exact shell literals from `render_prompt.sh`.
  WHY: It is a source-pattern test that will break on harmless quoting or naming refactors even if behavior stays correct.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:425-440 | severity=critical | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The fallback-path `SEMBLE_FALLBACK` log format lost the `ms=` field.
  WHY: Existing telemetry assertions expect `ms=`, and removing it weakens the ability to distinguish immediate failures from near-timeout failures.
